get.description: Initiate Google OAuth login
Handle Google OAuth callback

Get Google OAuth authorization URL for frontend flow.
Frontend should redirect user to this URL.

This endpoint returns the Google OAuth URL with frontend redirect URI,
so Google only sees the frontend domain, not the backend.

post.description:
Exchange Google OAuth code for user session token.

Frontend calls this after receiving the code from Google callback.
Backend exchanges code → gets user info → creates/updates user → returns session token.

This keeps the backend URL hidden from Google.
